<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>EXPLANATORY NOTE </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Tenneco Inc. (the &#147;Company&#148; or &#147;Tenneco&#148;) originally filed a Registration Statement on Form 10 (File <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">No.&nbsp;001-12387)</FONT> with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the &#147;SEC&#148;) on October&nbsp;30, 1996, to register its common stock, par&nbsp;value $0.01 per share, pursuant to Section&nbsp;12(b) the
Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the &#147;Exchange Act&#148;), and filed Amendment No.&nbsp;1 to the Registration Statement on Form 10 with the SEC on November&nbsp;4, 1996 and Amendment No.&nbsp;2 to the Registration Statement on Form
10 with the SEC on November&nbsp;6, 1996 (as so amended, the &#147;Registration Statement on Form&nbsp;10&#148;). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">On October&nbsp;1,
2018, the Company filed an amended and restated Certificate of Incorporation (the&nbsp;&#147;Amended and Restated Certificate&#148;) with the Secretary of State of the State of Delaware in order to, among other things, change the name of its common
stock to &#147;Class&nbsp;A Voting Common Stock&#148; and to create a new class of <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-voting</FONT> common stock, Class&nbsp;B <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-Voting</FONT> Common Stock, par value $0.01 per
share, of the Company. No changes were made to the economic or voting rights of the common stock that was renamed &#147;Class&nbsp;A Voting Common Stock.&#148; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Company is filing this Amendment No.&nbsp;3 to the Registration Statement on Form 10 to amend and restate in its entirety &#147;Item 11.
Description of Registrant&#146;s Securities to be Registered&#148; solely for the purpose of reflecting the change in the name of the outstanding common stock and reflecting certain other revisions set forth in the Amended and Restated Certificate
and the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">By-Laws</FONT> of the Company, as amended on October&nbsp;1, 2018 (the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">&#147;By-Laws&#148;).</FONT> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The name of the Company&#146;s common stock listed on the New York Stock Exchange (the &#147;NYSE&#148;) will be changed from &#147;Common
Stock&#148; to &#147;Class&nbsp;A Voting Common Stock&#148; on October&nbsp;2, 2018. The ticker symbol and CUSIP number remain the same. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">All of the other information set forth in the Registration Statement on Form 10 has been updated through the reports and other documents filed
by the Company with the SEC under the Exchange Act. Accordingly, the information required by all Items of Form 10, other than Item 11, is hereby incorporated by reference from the following documents: </P>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TD WIDTH="9%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><B>Item&nbsp;11.</B></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left"><B>Description of Registrant&#146;s Securities to be Registered. </B></P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><I>General </I></B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The following description
of our common stock is only a summary and is subject to the provisions of the Amended and Restated Certificate and the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">By-Laws,</FONT> which are included as exhibits to this Amendment No.&nbsp;3, and the applicable
provisions of the General Corporation Law of the State of Delaware (the &#147;DGCL&#148;). This information may not be complete in all respects and is qualified entirely by reference to the provisions of the Amended and Restated Certificate, the <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">By-Laws</FONT> and the DGCL. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Our authorized capital stock consists of 250,000,000 shares, consisting of:
175,000,000 shares of Class&nbsp;A Voting Common Stock, par value $0.01 per share (the &#147;Class&nbsp;A Common Stock&#148;), 25,000,000 shares of Class&nbsp;B <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-Voting</FONT> Common Stock, par value $0.01 per
share (the &#147;Class&nbsp;B Common Stock&#148; and together with the Class&nbsp;A Common Stock, the &#147;Common Stock&#148;), and 50,000,000 shares of preferred stock, par value $0.01 per share. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">1 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><I>Class&nbsp;A Common Stock and Class&nbsp;B Common Stock </I></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The rights of the Class&nbsp;A Common Stock and the Class&nbsp;B Common Stock are the same, except with respect to voting and conversion. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><I>Voting </I></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Holders of Class&nbsp;A Common
Stock are entitled to one vote for each share on any matter submitted to a vote of stockholders. Except as set forth below and except as otherwise required by law, the holders of outstanding shares of Class&nbsp;B Common Stock will not be entitled
to any votes upon any matters presented to stockholders. Except as otherwise required by law or provided in any resolution adopted by the board of directors of the Company (the&nbsp;&#147;Board&#148;) with respect to any series of preferred stock,
the holders of Class&nbsp;A Common Stock possess 100&nbsp;percent of the voting power of the Company. The Amended and Restated Certificate does not provide for cumulative voting in the election of directors. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Unless approved by a unanimous vote of the holders of the Class&nbsp;B Common Stock, the Company will not take any action that would
(i)&nbsp;diminish, impair, limit, restrict or avoid, or seek to do any of the foregoing with respect to any of the rights, powers or privileges of the Class&nbsp;B Common Stock or the observances or performance of any of the terms of the Amended and
Restated Certificate to be observed or performed by the Company, or (ii)&nbsp;permit, allow or agree to the diminishment, impairment, limitation, restriction or avoidance of, the observance or performance of any of the terms of the Amended and
Restated Certificate to be observed or performed by the Company. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><I>Dividends and Distributions </I></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Subject to preferences that may apply to any outstanding shares of preferred stock that may be created by the Board, the holders of
Class&nbsp;A Common Stock and Class&nbsp;B Common Stock will be entitled to share equally, on a per share basis, in any dividend or distribution of cash, property or shares of our capital stock that is paid or distributed by the Company. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Notwithstanding the forgoing, the Board may declare a dividend of any securities of the Company or of any other corporation, limited liability
company or other legal entity (a &#147;Share Distribution&#148;) to the holders of Class&nbsp;A Common Stock and Class&nbsp;B Common Stock (i)&nbsp;on the basis of a ratable distribution of identical securities to holders of Class&nbsp;A Common
Stock and Class&nbsp;B Common Stock or (ii)&nbsp;on the basis of a distribution of one class or series of securities to holders of Class&nbsp;A Common Stock and another class or series of securities to holders of Class&nbsp;B Common Stock, provided
that the securities so distributed do not differ in any respect other than (x)&nbsp;differences in their rights (other than voting rights and powers) consistent in all material respects with differences between Class&nbsp;A Common Stock and
Class&nbsp;B Common Stock and (y)&nbsp;differences in their relative voting rights and powers, with holders of Class&nbsp;A Common Stock receiving the class or series of such securities having the higher relative voting rights or powers (without
regard to whether such voting rights or powers differ to a greater or lesser extent than the corresponding differences in the voting rights or powers of Class&nbsp;A Common Stock and Class&nbsp;B Common Stock). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><I>Liquidation Rights </I></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Upon our liquidation,
dissolution or winding up, holders of Class&nbsp;A Common Stock and Class&nbsp;B Common Stock will be entitled to share equally, on a per share basis, in all assets remaining after payment of any liabilities and the liquidation preferences and any
accrued or declared but unpaid dividends, if any, with respect to any outstanding shares of preferred stock. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><I>Conversion Rights </I></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Holders of Class&nbsp;A Common Stock have no right to convert their Class&nbsp;A Common Stock into other securities. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Upon any transfer of shares of our Class&nbsp;B Common Stock, such shares will automatically convert into an equal number of shares of
Class&nbsp;A Common Stock, except for certain <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-converting</FONT> transfers described in our Amended and Restated Certificate, including the following: </P>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">any transfer of shares of Class&nbsp;B Common Stock to a broker or other nominee, provided that the transferor,
immediately following such transfer, retains (i)&nbsp;control over the disposition of such shares and (ii)&nbsp;the economic consequences of ownership of such shares; </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">2 </P>

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">any transfer of all, but not less than all, of the Class&nbsp;A Common Stock and Class&nbsp;B Common Stock then

</P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">In addition, if the Company does not consummate (or&nbsp;abandons) the proposed
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">spin-off</FONT> of its aftermarket and ride performance business by the date that is 18 months after the closing date of the Company&#146;s acquisition of Federal-Mogul pursuant to the Purchase Agreement, each holder
of Class&nbsp;B Common Stock may convert a number of such shares into an equal number of shares of Class&nbsp;A Common Stock, provided that such conversion would not result in such holder, AEP, IEH, IEP and any of their affiliates owning, in the
aggregate, more than 15&nbsp;percent of the Class&nbsp;A Common Stock issued and outstanding immediately following such conversion. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><I>Preemptive Rights
</I></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The holders of the Class&nbsp;A Common Stock have no preemptive rights with respect to future offerings of equity securities by the
Company, provided, however, that for so long as IEP and its affiliates own at least 10&nbsp;percent of the outstanding Class&nbsp;A Common Stock and Class&nbsp;B Common Stock, measured as a single class, IEP and its affiliates have certain
preemptive rights by contract under the Shareholders Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">If the Company proposes to issue equity securities of any kind, except in
certain excluded issuances, the&nbsp;Company shall deliver to IEP and its affiliates a written notice, which notice shall state the material terms of the securities proposed to be issued (the &#147;Proposed Securities&#148;), the price and other
terms of the proposed sale of such securities and the amount of such securities proposed to be issued (the &#147;Notice&#148;), at least five business days prior to the date of the proposed issuance, and offer to issue and sell to IEP and its
affiliates, on such terms as the Proposed Securities are to be issued, a portion of the Proposed Securities equal to IEP&#146;s and its affiliates&#146; pro rata beneficial ownership of the Common Stock (together with any other voting capital stock
owned by IEP and its affiliates, the &#147;Voting Stock&#148;) at such time as compared to the total number of shares of Class&nbsp;A Common Stock, Class&nbsp;B Common Stock and Voting Stock, considered together, outstanding immediately prior to the
issuance of the Proposed Securities; provided that the Class&nbsp;A Common Stock, the Class&nbsp;B Common Stock, any Voting Stock and any <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-voting</FONT> equity securities shall be issued in relative proportions
that preserve, but do not increase, the voting power that IEP and its affiliates had immediately prior to the issuance of the Proposed Securities. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><I>No
Redemption Rights </I></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">There are no redemption or sinking fund provisions applicable to the Class&nbsp;A Common Stock or the Class&nbsp;B
Common Stock. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><I>Subject to Rights of Preferred Stock </I></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The rights of the holders of Class&nbsp;A Common Stock and Class&nbsp;B Common Stock are subject to, and may be adversely affected by, the
rights of holders of any shares of preferred stock that the Company may designate and issue in the future. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><I>Antitakeover Effects of Certain
Provisions </I></B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Amended and Restated Certificate, <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">By-Laws</FONT> and DGCL contain certain
provisions that could make the acquisition of the Company by means of a tender offer, a proxy contest or otherwise more difficult. The description set forth below is intended as a summary only and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the
Amended and Restated Certificate and <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">By-Laws,</FONT> which are filed as exhibits to the Company&#146;s Current Report on Form <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">8-K</FONT> filed on October&nbsp;1, 2018. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">3 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><I>Number of Directors, Removal; Filling Vacancies </I></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Amended and Restated Certificate provides that the business and affairs of the Company will be managed by or under the direction of the
Board, consisting of not less than eight nor more than sixteen directors, the exact number thereof to be determined from time to time by affirmative vote of a majority of the entire Board. In addition, the Amended and Restated Certificate provides
that any vacancy on the Board that results from an increase in the number of directors may be filled by a majority of the directors then in office, provided that a quorum is present, and any other vacancy occurring in the Board may be filled by a
majority of the directors then in office, even if less than a quorum, or by a sole remaining director. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Notwithstanding the foregoing, the
Amended and Restated Certificate provides that whenever the holders of any one or more series of preferred stock have the right, voting separately as a class or series, to elect directors, the election, removal, term of office, filling of vacancies
and other features of such directorships will be governed by the terms of the Amended and Restated Certificate applicable to that preferred stock or the resolutions adopted by the Board applicable thereto. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><I>Special Meeting</I></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">By-Laws</FONT> provide that special meetings of stockholders may be called by the Board, subject to the rights of any holders of preferred stock. Moreover, the business permitted to be conducted at any special meeting of
stockholders is limited to the purposes specified in the notice of meeting given by the Company. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><I>Advance Notice Provisions for Stockholder
Nominations, Stockholder Proposals and Proxy Access </I></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">By-Laws</FONT> establish an advance notice
procedure for stockholders to make nominations of candidates for election of directors and to bring other business before an annual meeting of stockholders and to make nominations of candidates for election of directors at a special meeting of
stockholders called for the purpose of electing one or more directors. The <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">By-Laws</FONT> also provide proxy access to certain qualifying stockholders to make nominations for candidates for election of directors.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Generally, for a stockholder notice to be timely in respect of (i)&nbsp;an annual meeting, such notice must be delivered to the principal
executive offices of the Company, not later than the close of business on the 90th&nbsp;day nor earlier than the close of business on the 120th&nbsp;day prior to the first anniversary of the preceding year&#146;s annual meeting, and (ii)&nbsp;a
special meeting called for the purpose of electing one or more directors, such notice must be delivered to the principal executive offices of the Company not earlier than the close of business on the 120th day prior to such special meeting and not
later than the close of business on the later of the 90th prior to such special meeting or the 10th day following the day on which public announcement is first made of the date of the special meeting and of the nominees proposed by the Board to be
elected at such special meeting. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Under the proxy <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">access&nbsp;By-Law&nbsp;provision,</FONT> qualifying
stockholders are allowed to include their director nominees in the Company&#146;s proxy materials under certain circumstances by giving adequate and timely notice to the Secretary of the Company. A stockholder or group of no more than 20
stockholders (meeting the Company&#146;s continuous ownership requirement of 3&nbsp;percent or more of the Company&#146;s outstanding common stock held continuously for at least the previous three years) can&nbsp;nominate a candidate or candidates
for election to the Board at an annual meeting, constituting up to two directors or 20&nbsp;percent of the number of directors then serving on the Board (rounded down to the nearest whole number), whichever is greater, provided that the
stockholder(s) and nominee(s) satisfy the requirements specified in <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">the&nbsp;By-Laws.&nbsp;In</FONT> order for such nominees to be included in the Company&#146;s proxy statement, stockholders and nominees must submit
a notice of proxy access nomination together with certain related information required by <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">the&nbsp;By-Laws.&nbsp;The&nbsp;By-Laws&nbsp;state</FONT></FONT> that, to be timely, the
notice and the related information must be delivered to the Company&#146;s principal executive offices not earlier than the close of business on the 150th day nor later than the close of business on the 120th day prior to the first anniversary of
the date that the Company&#146;s proxy statement was first distributed to stockholders in connection with the preceding year&#146;s annual meeting. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><I>Record Date Procedure for Stockholder Action by Written Consent </I></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">By-Laws</FONT> establish a procedure for the fixing of a record date in respect of corporate action
proposed to be taken by the stockholders of the Company by written consent in lieu of a meeting. The <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">By-Laws</FONT> provide that any person seeking to have the stockholders authorize or take corporate action by
written consent without a meeting shall, by written notice addressed to our Secretary and delivered to our company, request that a record date be fixed for such purpose. The <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">By-Laws</FONT> state the Board may fix a
record date for such purpose which shall be no more than 10&nbsp;days after the date upon which the resolution fixing the record date is adopted by the Board. If the Board fails within 10&nbsp;days after the Company receives such notice to fix
</P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">4 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">
a record date for such purpose, the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">By-Laws</FONT> provide that the record date shall be the date after the expiration of such ten day time period on or the day
on which the first written consent is delivered to us unless prior action by the Board is required under the DGCL, in which event the record date shall be at the close of business on the day on which the Board adopts the resolution taking such prior
action. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">By-Laws</FONT> also provide that the Secretary of the Company or, under certain
circumstances, two inspectors designated by the Secretary, shall promptly conduct the ministerial review of the sufficiency of any written consents of stockholders duly delivered to the Company and of the validity of the action to be taken by
stockholder consent as he or she deems necessary or appropriate, including, without limitation, whether the holders of a number of shares having the requisite voting power to authorize or take the action specified in the written consent have given
consent. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><I>Stockholder Meetings </I></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">By-Laws</FONT> provide that the Board and the chairman of a meeting may adopt rules and regulations for the conduct of stockholder meetings as they deem appropriate (including the establishment of an agenda, rules relating
to presence at the meeting of persons other than stockholders, restrictions on entry at the meeting after commencement thereof and the imposition of time limitations for questions by participants at the meeting). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><I>Preferred Stock </I></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Amended and Restated
Certificate authorizes the Board to provide for series of preferred stock and, with respect to each such series, to fix the number of shares constituting such series and the designation of such series, the voting powers (if any) of the shares of
such series, and the preferences and relative, participating, optional or other special rights, if any, and any qualifications, limitations or restrictions thereof, of the shares of such series. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Company believes that the ability of the Board to issue one or more series of preferred stock provides it with flexibility in structuring
possible future financings and acquisitions, and in meeting other corporate needs that might arise. The authorized shares of the preferred stock, as well as shares of Common Stock, will be available for issuance without further action by our
stockholders, unless action is required by applicable law or the rules of any stock exchange or automated quotation system on which our securities may be listed or traded. The NYSE currently requires stockholder approval as a prerequisite to listing
shares in several instances, including in some cases where the present or potential issuance of shares could result in a 20&nbsp;percent increase in the number of share of Common Stock outstanding or in the amount of voting securities outstanding.
If the approval of stockholders of the Company is not required for the issuance of shares of preferred stock or Common Stock, the Board may determine not to seek stockholder approval. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Although the Board has no intention at the present time of doing so, it could issue a series of preferred stock that could, depending on the
terms of such series, impede the completion of a merger, tender offer or other takeover attempt. The Board will make any determination to issue such shares based on its judgment as to the best interests of the Company and its stockholders. The
Board, in so acting, could issue preferred stock having terms that could discourage an acquisition attempt through which an acquirer may be able to change the composition of the Board, including a tender offer or other transaction that some, or a
majority, of the stockholders of the Company might believe to be in their best interests or in which stockholders might receive a premium for their stock over the then current market price of such stock. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><I>Business Combinations </I></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Amended and
Restated Certificate prohibits any &#147;Business Combination&#148; (as defined in the Amended and Restated Certificate) with &#147;Interested Stockholders&#148; (as defined in the Amended and Restated Certificate) without the approval of the
holders of at least 66 2/3&nbsp;percent of the votes entitled to be cast by holders of all the then outstanding shares of stock entitled to vote on all matters submitted to stockholders of the Company generally (&#147;Voting Shares&#148;) not owned
by an Interested Stockholder unless (i)&nbsp;the Business Combination is approved by a majority of the &#147;Continuing Directors&#148; (as defined in our Amended and Restated Certificate) or (ii)&nbsp;certain detailed requirements as to, among
other things, the value and type of consideration to be paid to the stockholders of the Company, the maintenance of the dividend policy of the Company, the public disclosure of the Business Combination and the absence of any major change in the
business or equity capital structure of the Company without the approval of a majority of the Continuing Directors, have been satisfied. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">5 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Amended and Restated Certificate generally defines an &#147;Interested Stockholder&#148;
as any person (other&nbsp;than the Company or any subsidiary, any employee benefit plan of the Company or any subsidiary or any trustee or fiduciary with respect to any such plan or holding Voting Shares for the purpose of funding any such plan or
funding other employee benefits for employees of us or any subsidiary when acting in such capacity) who (i)&nbsp;is or has announced or publicly disclosed a plan or intention to become the beneficial owner of Voting Shares representing five percent
or more of the votes entitled to be cast by the holders of all then outstanding Voting Shares or (ii)&nbsp;is&nbsp;an affiliate or associate of the Company and at any time within the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">two-year</FONT> period
immediately prior to the date in question was the beneficial owner of Voting Shares representing five percent or more of the votes entitled to be cast by the holders of all then outstanding Voting Shares. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Amended and Restated Certificate defines a &#147;Continuing Director&#148; as any member of the Board, while such person is a member of
the Board, who is not an affiliate or associate or representative of the Interested Stockholder and was a member of the Board prior to the time that the Interested Stockholder became an Interested Stockholder, and any successor thereto, while such
successor is a member of the Board, who is not an affiliate or associate or representative of the Interested Stockholder and is recommended or elected to succeed the Continuing Director by a majority of Continuing Directors. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><I>Amendment of Certain Provisions of the Certificate of Incorporation and <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">By-Laws</FONT> </I></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Under the DGCL, the stockholders of a corporation have the right to adopt, amend or repeal the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">by-laws</FONT>
and, with the approval of the board of directors, the certificate of incorporation of a corporation. In addition, if the certificate of incorporation so provides, the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">by-laws</FONT> may be adopted, amended or
repealed by the board of directors. The Amended and Restated Certificate provides that the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">By-Laws</FONT> may be amended by the Board or by the stockholders of the Company. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Amended and Restated Certificate also provides that any proposal to amend or repeal, or adopt any provision inconsistent with, the
provisions of the Amended and Restated Certificate regarding Business Combinations proposed by or on behalf of an Interested Stockholder or affiliate thereof requires (at a minimum) the affirmative vote of the holders of at least 66 2/3&nbsp;percent
of the votes entitled to be cast by holders of the outstanding Voting Shares, excluding Voting Shares beneficially owned by any Interested Stockholder, unless the proposal is unanimously recommended by the Board and each director qualifies as a
Continuing Director. Approval by the Board, together with the affirmative vote of the holders of a majority in voting power of the outstanding Voting Shares, is required to amend all other provisions of the Amended and Restated Certificate. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Business Combination supermajority voting requirement could have the effect of making more difficult any amendment by stockholders of the
Business Combination provisions of the Amended and Restated Certificate described above, even if a majority of the stockholders of the Company believe that such amendment would be in their best interest. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><I>Antitakeover Legislation </I></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Section&nbsp;203 of the DGCL provides that, subject to certain exceptions specified herein, a corporation shall not engage in any
&#147;business combination&#148; with any &#147;interested stockholder&#148; for a three-year period following the time that such stockholder becomes an interested stockholder unless: </P>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(i)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">prior to such time, the board of directors of the corporation approved either the business combination or the
transaction which resulted in the stockholder becoming an interested stockholder; </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(ii)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">upon consummation of the transaction which resulted in the stockholder becoming an interested stockholder, the
interested stockholder owned at least 85&nbsp;percent of the voting stock of the corporation outstanding at the time the transaction commenced (excluding certain shares); or </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(iii)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">on or subsequent to such time the business combination is approved by the board of directors of the corporation
and authorized at any annual or special meeting of stockholders, and not by written consent, by the affirmative vote of at least 66 2/3&nbsp;percent of the outstanding voting stock which is not owned by the interested stockholder.
</P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Section&nbsp;203 of the DGCL generally defines an &#147;interested stockholder&#148; to include (x)&nbsp;any person
that is the owner of 15&nbsp;percent or more of the outstanding voting stock of the corporation, or is an affiliate or associate of the corporation and was the owner of 15&nbsp;percent or more of the outstanding voting stock of the corporation at
any time within three years immediately prior to the relevant date and (y)&nbsp;the affiliates and associates of any such person. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">6 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Section&nbsp;203 of the DGCL generally defines a &#147;business combination&#148; to include
(1)&nbsp;any merger or consolidation involving the corporation and the interested stockholders; (2)&nbsp;any merger, sale or other disposition of 10&nbsp;percent or more of the assets of the corporation with or to an interested stockholder;
(3)&nbsp;subject to certain exceptions, any transaction that results in the issuance or transfer by the corporation of any stock of the corporation to the interested stockholder; (4)&nbsp;any transaction which would result in increasing the
proportionate share of the stock of the corporation or its subsidiaries owned by the interested stockholder; and (5)&nbsp;the&nbsp;receipt by the interested stockholder of the benefit (except proportionately as a stockholder) of any loans, advances,
guarantees, pledges, or other financial benefits. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Under certain circumstances, Section&nbsp;203 of the DGCL makes it more difficult for a
person who would be an interested stockholder to effect various business combinations with a corporation for a three-year period, although a certificate of incorporation or stockholder-adopted <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">by-laws</FONT> may
exclude a corporation from the restrictions imposed thereunder. Neither the Amended and Restated Certificate nor the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">By-Laws</FONT> exclude the Company from the restrictions imposed upon Section&nbsp;203 of the DGCL.
It is anticipated that the provisions of Section&nbsp;203 of the DGCL may encourage companies interested in acquiring the Company to negotiate in advance with the Board since the stockholder approval requirement would be avoided if the Board
approves, prior to the time the stockholder becomes an interested stockholder, either the business combination or the transaction which results in the stockholder becoming an interested stockholder. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><I>Transfer Agent and Registrar</I></B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The
Transfer Agent and Registrar for our Common Stock is EQ Shareowner Services. Its address is 1110 Centre Pointe Curve Suite 101, Mendota Heights, MN 55120. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><I>Listing on the New York Stock Exchange</I></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Class&nbsp;A Common Stock is listed on the NYSE under the symbol &#147;TEN.&#148; </P>
